title: NEGATIVE: malicious-control -> RCE via auto-update is blocked by pinned-root signature verification
finding: distsign embeds root ed25519 pubkeys (roots.go:16 //go:embed roots). Client.Download (distsign.go:209-243) fetches file to dst+'.unverified', computes BLAKE2s hash+len, fetches .sig, and requires VerifyAny(signingKeys, hash||len, sig); signingKeys() (distsign.go:298-310) is itself VerifyAny(c.roots, bundle, sig) against the pinned roots. File is os.Rename'd into place ONLY after signature OK; on mismatch the .unverified file is removed and never executed. Overriding pkgsAddr does not help (sig still must chain to pinned roots).
implication: A repointed/attacker control server (or MITM of pkgs.tailscale.com) cannot deliver a runnable update binary without Tailscale's private signing key. The update c2n path is NOT a control->RCE chain.
